text: The will to win is not nearly as important as the will to prepare to win.
author: Bobby Knight

text: Do small things with great love.
author: Mother Teresa

text: It's not whether you get knocked down; it's whether you get up.
author: Vince Lombardi

text: Be who God meant you to be and you will set the world on fire.
author: St. Catherine of Siena

text: Have patience with all things, but first of all with yourself.
author: St. Francis de Sales

text: Failure is not fatal, but failure to change might be.
author: John Wooden

text: The most important shot in golf is the next one.
author: Ben Hogan

text: Miss no single opportunity of making some small sacrifice, here by a smiling look, there by a kindly word.
author: St. Thérèse of Lisieux

text: Whether you think you can, or you think you can't, you're right.
author: Henry Ford

text: Well done is better than well said.
author: Benjamin Franklin
